: Sensei...

label mikumountx:
scene mikumount1
: Miku?
lines.zh: : Miku？

lines.en: : Whaddya think yer’ doin’ sleeping in so late when we’ve got stuff to prepare for?
lines.zh: : 我们还有东西要准备呢，你咋还睡这么晚啊？

lines.en: : How did you get into my room?
lines.zh: : 你怎么进我房间的？

lines.en: : Actually, better question. How did you get into my house?
lines.zh: : 不对，更要紧的问题是——你怎么进我家的？

lines.en: scene mikumount2
: Oh. Ami let me in.
lines.zh: : 哦。Ami让我进来的。

lines.en: : She’s doing her hair and stuff and they sent me in here to wake you up since I was the least likely to “do anything weird.”
lines.zh: : 她在弄头发什么的，她们就派我进来叫你起床，因为我是最不可能“干出奇怪的事”的人。

lines.en: : So your response is to mount me?
lines.zh: : 所以你的对策是骑到我身上？

lines.en: scene mikumount3
: That’s right! Because what they don’t know is that I’m not actually Miku at all!
lines.zh: : 没错！因为她们不知道的是，我根本就不是Miku！

lines.en: : Then who are you exactly?...
lines.zh: : 那你到底是什么？……

lines.en: : A succubus! Or a demon! Or a bat!
lines.zh: : 魅魔！还是恶魔！还是蝙蝠！

lines.en: : Or something!
lines.zh: : 或者别的什么！

lines.en: scene mikumount4
: Actually, I just kinda kept adding random parts of costumes together until I got this.
lines.zh: : 其实吧，我就是随便把各种变装服的零件往上拼，拼着拼着就拼成这样了。

lines.en: : I haven’t grown much over the last couple of years, so this year I’m just all three costumes wrapped into one.
lines.zh: : 这两年我也没怎么长个，所以今年干脆把三套衣服裹成一套了。

lines.en: : Oh okay. I completely understand why you’re on top of me then.
lines.zh: : 哦，这样啊。那我完全理解你为什么压在我身上了。

lines.en: Miku’s weight presses down against my crotch, which isn’t exactly the smartest move to make on a perverted male first thing in the morning.
lines.zh: Miku的重量压在我胯上，一大早对一个变态男人做这种事实在算不上明智。

lines.en: Certain biological functions are bound to happen.
lines.zh: 某些生理反应是必然会发生的。

lines.en: And considering the house is full of other girls and no one ever seems to lock doors in Kumon-mi, this could quickly turn into a problem.
lines.zh: 而且考虑到这屋里全是女孩子，而 Kumon-mi 似乎从来没人锁门，这事很快就会变成麻烦。

lines.en: scene mikumount1
: I’m on top of you because I tapped ya on the shoulder a bunch of times and you just wouldn’t wake up.
lines.zh: : 我压在你身上，是因为我拍了你肩膀好多次，你就是不肯醒。

lines.en: : But I can see you’re {i}up{/i} now, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 不过我看你现在{i}起来{/i}了，Sensei。

lines.en: : You mean ‘awake,’ right?
lines.zh: : 你是说“醒了”对吧？

lines.en: scene mikumount5
: Hm? What else would I mean?
lines.zh: : 嗯？不然我还能说什么？

lines.en: : You just said “up” with a certain inflection that made me think you might be talking about something else.
lines.zh: : 你刚才说“起来”的语气有点那个，让我以为你在说别的事。

lines.en: : But what else would I be...
lines.zh: : 我还能在说别的什么……

lines.en: scene mikumount6
: Uhhhhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……

lines.en: : Finally catch on?
lines.zh: : 总算反应过来了？

lines.en: scene mikumount7
: I think so...
lines.zh: : 应该是吧……

lines.en: : Probably not a smart move to just...hop on ya first thing in the mornin’, huh?
lines.zh: : 一大早就直接往你身上跳，好像确实不太聪明哈？

lines.en: : I mean, I don’t have a problem with it.
lines.zh: : 我倒是无所谓。

lines.en: scene mikumount8
: H-How did you even get like...that?!
lines.zh: : 你、你怎么会变成……那样？！

lines.en: : Is it the wings?! It's the wings, isn't it?!
lines.zh: : 是翅膀吗？！是翅膀对不对？！

lines.en: : They definitely help, I won’t lie.
lines.zh: : 它们确实有加分，我不骗你。

lines.en: scene mikumount7
: Well, umm...uhh...
lines.zh: : 那个，嗯……呃……

lines.en: : What do we do now?...
lines.zh: : 那我们现在怎么办？……

lines.en: Miku freezes on top of me, being extra careful to not move at all.
lines.zh: Miku僵在我身上，特别小心地一动都不敢动。

lines.en: Probably out of fear of not...stimulating me even more or something.
lines.zh: 大概是怕再……刺激到我之类的。

lines.en: : What do you mean, “What do we do now?” Isn’t this the part where you {i}take responsibility{/i} or something?
lines.zh: : “我们现在怎么办”是什么意思？这难道不该是你{i}负责{/i}的部分吗？

lines.en: : I think that's standard procedure in situations like this.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这种情况的标准流程就是这样。

lines.en: scene mikumount8
: N-No way! I’m not even responsible enough to finish my homework! Like heck I’m gonna take responsibility for whatever it is I’m sitting on!
lines.zh: : 不——不可能！我连作业都负责不完！我怎么可能替我屁股底下坐着的东西负责！

lines.en: : So you’re just going to...sit there until it goes away?
lines.zh: : 所以你就打算……一直坐在那儿等它消下去？

lines.en: scene mikumount7
: How long does that normally take?
lines.zh: : 一般要多久啊？

lines.en: : Anywhere from a few minutes to...longer than that?
lines.zh: : 几分钟到……比那更久？

lines.en: : I can wait a few minutes.
lines.zh: : 等几分钟我还是能等的。

lines.en: : It’s not like I’m uncomfortable or anything.
lines.zh: : 我又没觉得不舒服什么的。

lines.en: : I didn’t even realize anything weird was underneath me until you pointed it out.
lines.zh: : 在你指出来之前，我压根没发现自己底下有什么奇怪的东西。

lines.en: : That’s kind of offensive, Miku.
lines.zh: : 这话有点伤人啊，Miku。

lines.en: : Shh! If you keep drawin' attention to it I’ll start thinkin’ weird things and then before I know it we’ll have three kids and a puppy.
lines.zh: : 嘘！你要是再提它，我脑子里就会开始想些乱七八糟的，然后不知不觉我们就有三个孩子和一条小狗了。

lines.en: : Did you lock the door at least?
lines.zh: : 你至少把门锁了吧？

lines.en: scene mikumount8
: 'Course I didn’t lock the heckin’ door! I didn’t expect ya to get all Dwayne “The Rock” Johnson on me!
lines.zh: : 我当——然没有锁那该死的门！我哪想到你会突然给我来个巨石强森啊！

lines.en: : What a strange way to describe an erection.
lines.zh: : 形容勃起的方式真够奇怪的。

lines.en: scene mikumount9
: Ahhh! This is the exact opposite reason of why the girls chose me to come in here!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！这跟她们挑我进来的理由完全是反着来的啊！

lines.en: : Won’t they get suspicious if you stay in here any longer, then?
lines.zh: : 那你再待久一点，她们不会起疑吗？

lines.en: : They probably already are suspicious!
lines.zh: : 她们八成已经起疑了！

lines.en: : They probably think you’re teaching me how to do the cowboy!
lines.zh: : 她们八成以为你在教我怎么玩牛仔女郎！

lines.en: : But if I just...get off of you then it’ll be all like “BAM” and smack me in the face and I’ll get knocked unconscious and stuff!
lines.zh: : 可要是我现在……从你身上下来，它就会“砰”一下弹上来扇我脸，然后我就会被打晕什么的！

lines.en: : How did you go from not feeling anything to worrying about it smacking you in the face?
lines.zh: : 你怎么从“什么都没感觉到”一下子跳到担心它扇你脸了？

lines.en: scene mikumount10
: How’d you go from thinkin’ I look like a boy to turnin’ into a statue when I get on top of ya?
lines.zh: : 那你怎么从“觉得我像个男孩子”一下子变成我一骑上来你就成雕像了？

lines.en: : I never said you look like a boy. That’s what {i}you{/i} always say.
lines.zh: : 我从来没说{i}你{/i}像男孩子。那是你自己一直这么说的。

lines.en: : In fact, I’m pretty sure I’ve told you I think you’re cute on several occasions now.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我很确定我已经说过好几次觉得你可爱了。

lines.en: scene mikumount11
: You mean those weren’t jokes?
lines.zh: : 你是说那些不是开玩笑？

lines.en: : Why would they be jokes?
lines.zh: : 为什么要开玩笑？

lines.en: : Well...ya know. I’m always surrounded by girls like Karin and Kirin and they make me look even more...Miku-ish than I already am.
lines.zh: : 就……你知道的。我身边总是围着Kirin和麒麟那种女生，搞得我看起来比本来还要……Miku。

lines.en: : I like Miku-ish girls, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我大概就是喜欢Miku这种女孩子吧。

lines.en: scene mikumount12
: Well, um...th-thanks.
lines.zh: : 那个，嗯……谢、谢谢。

lines.en: : I’ll try to remember that if the others ever trust me enough to wake ya up again...
lines.zh: : 下次要是她们还放心让我来叫你起床，我会记住的……

lines.en: : Ya know. So I don't...turn you into The Rock and stuff.
lines.zh: : 你知道的。这样我就不会……把你变成巨石强森什么的。

lines.en: : Is it back to normal yet?
lines.zh: : 恢复正常了吗？

lines.en: : Not even close.
lines.zh: : 差得远呢。

lines.en: scene mikumount13
: Really?...
lines.zh: : 真的假的？……

lines.en: : Being a boy sounds hard. Like really hard.
lines.zh: : 当男孩子听起来好辛苦。真的好辛苦。

lines.en: : Like, super duper extra friggin’ hard.
lines.zh: : 就是，超级无敌特别特么辛苦。

lines.en: : Are we still talking about being a boy or have you moved on to talking about my penis?
lines.zh: : 我们还在聊当男孩子的事吗，还是已经转到我的鸡巴上了？

lines.en: : I don’t know. I’m feelin’ a lot of stuff I don’t normally feel right now.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我现在感觉到了一堆平时不会有的东西。

lines.en: : I don’t even know if I {i}could{/i} get up right now if I wanted to. My legs feel all stiff and stuff.
lines.zh: : 就算我想起来，我都不确定自己{i}起不起得来{/i}。腿僵得要命。

lines.en: : I can relate to that.
lines.zh: : 这点我深有同感。

lines.en: : Yeah, I friggin’ know ya can relate to that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我特么知道你深有同感。

lines.en: Several minutes have gone by with Miku just...sitting on my lap.
lines.zh: 就这样过了好几分钟，Miku只是……坐在我腿上。

lines.en: Her body is light and warm, but that’s really all I can say about it right now on account of her vehemently refusing to move.
lines.zh: 她的身体又轻又暖，但鉴于她死活不肯动，我现在也只能说这么多了。

lines.en: scene mikumount14
: So, ya excited for the party tonight?
lines.zh: : 话说，今晚的派对你期待吗？

lines.en: : Are we just going to have a normal conversation now?
lines.zh: : 我们现在是要正常聊天了吗？

lines.en: : Well it beats all the innuendos, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 总比满嘴黄腔强吧？

lines.en: : I know I don’t look like one, but a girl can only handle so much before her brain melts, ya know?
lines.zh: : 我知道我看着不像，但一个女孩子的脑子能承受的量是有限的，你知道吧？

lines.en: : And it’s not helpin’ that you’re half-naked and stuff.
lines.zh: : 而且你还半裸着什么的，一点忙都帮不上。

lines.en: : Someone could get the wrong idea really quick if they saw us like this.
lines.zh: : 要是有人看到我们这样，肯定会立刻误会的。

lines.en: scene mikumount15
: Yes, God forbid someone got the wrong idea after seeing {i}this.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是啊，老天保佑别有人看到{i}这一幕{/i}后误会。

lines.en: Makoto turns on the lights and angrily walks over to the bed.
lines.zh: Makoto啪地打开灯，气冲冲地走到床边。

lines.en: I think I am in trouble.
lines.zh: 我想我有麻烦了。

lines.en: : Miku, mind explaining what it is the two of you are doing, exactly?
lines.zh: : Miku，能解释一下你们两个到底在干什么吗？

lines.en: : ...Just hangin’ out.
lines.zh: : ……就待着啊。

lines.en: : Just hanging out. I see.
lines.zh: : 就待着。我明白了。

lines.en: : Sensei, do you have anything to add to that?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你有什么要补充的吗？

lines.en: : Good morning, Makoto. You look nice today.
lines.zh: : 早上好，Makoto。你今天看起来很漂亮。

lines.en: scene mikumount16
: Don’t try and fend me off with compliments, bastard!
lines.zh: : 少拿恭维话来搪塞我，混蛋！

lines.en: : Why is Miku riding you like you’re some sort of mechanical bull?!
lines.zh: : Miku为什么像骑机械公牛一样骑在你身上？！

lines.en: : Mechanical...bull?...
lines.zh: : 机械……公牛？……

lines.en: : She’s just sitting there. She isn’t riding me at all.
lines.zh: : 她只是坐着而已。她根本没有骑我。

lines.en: scene mikumount17
: If she’s just sitting there, why doesn’t she get off?
lines.zh: : 如果只是坐着，那她为什么不下来？

lines.en: : You’re awake, aren’t you? Isn't that what she came in here to do?
lines.zh: : 你已经醒了，不是吗？她进来不就是为了这个？

lines.en: : Oh, r-right! Sensei is awake!
lines.zh: : 哦，对、对！Sensei已经醒了！

lines.en: : My job here is done!
lines.zh: : 我的任务完成了！

lines.en: : I...still don’t think it’s safe to get up, though!
lines.zh: : 不过……我还是觉得现在起来不安全！

lines.en: scene mikumount18
: And why is that, my self-proclaimed best friend?
lines.zh: : 这是为什么，我自称的挚友？

lines.en: : Well, you see Makoto, there’s um...
lines.zh: : 那个，Makoto你看，就是……

lines.en: : There's {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 就是{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: scene mikumount19
: SENSEI HAS A BONER AND I’M AFRAID IT WILL SLAP ME IN THE FACE IF I GET OFF OF IT!
lines.zh: : 老师勃起了，我要是下来，怕它一巴掌扇我脸上！

lines.en: : I’M SORRY!
lines.zh: : 对不起！

lines.en: : Wow, you crack easily when Makoto is involved, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 哇，一碰到Makoto你就这么容易招供啊。

lines.en: scene mikumount20
: It’s been an action-packed morning and I’ve only been up for an hour! Gimme a friggin’ break!
lines.zh: : 这个早上太刺激了，我才刚起床一个小时！让我特么喘口气吧！

lines.en: : Miku.
lines.zh: : Miku。

lines.en: : Step away from the penis.
lines.zh: : 从鸡巴旁边退开。

lines.en: scene mikumount21
: Ugh! Fine!
lines.zh: : 呃！知道了！

lines.en: : But this really isn’t my fault!
lines.zh: : 但这真的不是我的错！

lines.en: scene black
Does that mean it’s my fault?
lines.zh: 那意思是我的错咯？

lines.en: But I didn’t even do anything wrong this time.
lines.zh: 可我这次什么都没做错啊。

lines.en: jump mikumount
label mikumount:
scene mikumount22
I get off the bed and stand before Mak-
lines.zh: 我下了床，站到真……

lines.en: : Actually, Sensei. Why don’t you take a seat?
lines.zh: : 不过Sensei，你为什么不坐下呢？

lines.en: : I don’t think you’re, uhh, {i}ready{/i} to stand up just yet.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你还没……{i}准备好{/i}站起来。

lines.en: : Oh. Yeah, that makes sense.
lines.zh: : 哦。也对。

lines.en: I sit back down on the bed after Makoto makes me acutely aware that I have not yet “calmed down.”
lines.zh: Makoto让我清楚地意识到自己还没“冷静下来”，于是我又坐回了床上。

lines.en: : Do you have any idea why I’m here?
lines.zh: : 你知道我为什么在这儿吗？

lines.en: : I imagine it’s because Miku was taking too long to wake me up.
lines.zh: : 我猜是因为Miku叫了我太久还没叫醒。

lines.en: : Well I...got the job done, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 可我……任务完成了啊，不是吗？

lines.en: : I mean why I’m at your house.
lines.zh: : 我是问我为什么会在你家。

lines.en: : Oh. I imagine it’s something involving the Halloween party based on the way you’re dressed.
lines.zh: : 哦。看你这身打扮，我猜是跟万圣节派对有关。

lines.en: : Precisely.
lines.zh: : 正是。

lines.en: : You are aware that the party tonight is at the Amamiya estate, correct?
lines.zh: : 你应该知道今晚的派对在天宫家举行吧？

lines.en: : I am aware, yes.
lines.zh: : 我知道，是的。

lines.en: : And have you been informed by any of the connected parties that your assistance is required to set the stage for the occasion?
lines.zh: : 那有没有相关人士通知过你，布置现场需要你帮忙？

lines.en: : Set the stage? You mean I actually have to help prepare?
lines.zh: : 布置现场？你是说我真的得帮忙准备？

lines.en: : Doesn’t Ayane’s family have like...servants or something they could use?
lines.zh: : Ayane家不是有……佣人之类的可以用吗？

lines.en: : What about that Geoffrey guy?
lines.zh: : 那个叫杰弗里的家伙呢？

lines.en: : Geoffrey fell mysteriously ill last night.
lines.zh: : 杰弗里昨晚神秘地病倒了。

lines.en: : He is fine, but since this party is being held without Ayane’s father’s permission, the two of us have been chosen to get everything ready.
lines.zh: : 他没事，不过由于这场派对是瞒着Ayane的父亲办的，所以选了我们两个来把一切准备妥当。

lines.en: : That includes shopping for food and drinks as well as managing the lighting and sound systems.
lines.zh: : 包括采购食物和饮料，以及管理灯光和音响设备。

lines.en: : Why do I have to be involved in this?
lines.zh: : 为什么非得拉上我？

lines.en: scene mikumount23
: Oh, that’s easy. Because you can carry more things than everyone else.
lines.zh: : 哦，这很简单。因为你比其他人都能搬东西。

lines.en: : And also, you’re the only person coming to the party without a costume, so you need less time to prepare.
lines.zh: : 而且，来参加派对的人里只有你没穿变装服，所以你需要准备的时间最少。

lines.en: : Of course, there’s the time required for a certain part of you to...return to normal-
lines.zh: : 当然，你身上某个部位需要花点时间……恢复正常——

lines.en: : But I trust that you and Miku were about to take care of that any minute, now weren’t you?
lines.zh: : 不过我相信你和Miku马上就会处理好的，是吧？

lines.en: scene mikumount24
: Wha-
: We were not! I told you I was just afraid of bein’ slapped in the face by it!
lines.zh: : 我们没有！我都说了，我只是怕被它扇脸！

lines.en: : You really expect me to believe that?
lines.zh: : 你真以为我会信？

lines.en: : Yes!
scene mikumount25
: Hah...well, whatever the case...just get dressed and get ready so the two of us can go on a little shopping trip.
lines.zh: : 哈……算了，不管怎样……去换好衣服准备一下，我们两个要出去小小采购一趟。

lines.en: : Everyone else is going to be heading to Ayane’s early and hanging out in her ballroom until then.
lines.zh: : 其他人会提早去Ayane家，在那之前先在她的舞厅里待着。

lines.en: : I believe the mansion has a separate section where we’ll be holding the party, so I’ll have her show us to it once we get there several hours from now.
lines.zh: : 我记得宅邸里有一处独立的区域是我们要办派对的地方，所以几小时后到了那儿，我会让她带我们过去。

lines.en: : Why do you have to be so responsible all the time?
lines.zh: : 你为什么总是这么靠谱？

lines.en: scene mikumount26
: I need to be or, at this rate, you’ll wind up stealing everyone’s virginity and endangering your career.
lines.zh: : 我必须靠谱，不然照这个势头下去，你会把所有人的初夜都偷走，还会毁了自己的职业生涯。

lines.en: : I’m never gonna hear the end of this, am I...
lines.zh: : 这件事我是永远都洗不清了，是吧……

lines.en: scene black
What Makoto doesn’t realize is that stealing everyone's virginity is my exact mission.
lines.zh: Makoto不知道的是，偷走所有人的初夜正是我的使命。

lines.en: But regardless, the two of them leave the room and I get changed, meeting back up with Makoto moments later.
lines.zh: 不过不管怎样，她们两个离开了房间，我换了衣服，片刻后和Makoto会合。

lines.en: scene sky
We spend the next few hours scavenging various grocery stores, picking up small things and party favors from all of them.
lines.zh: 接下来的几个小时里，我们扫荡了各家杂货店，从每家都买了些小东西和派对小玩意儿。

lines.en: I figured that her attitude would get better throughout the day, but that is very much not the case.
lines.zh: 我本以为她的态度会一整天慢慢好转，但事实远非如此。

lines.en: Her resentment lingers and she has no trouble constantly reminding me of how innocent Miku is and how I’m just trying to corrupt her.
lines.zh: 她的怨气一直散不掉，而且毫不介意地反复提醒我——Miku有多单纯，而我只是在试图把她带坏。

lines.en: And while that isn’t {i}entirely{/i} incorrect, it’s not entirely correct either.
lines.zh: 虽然这话也不算{i}全{/i}错，但也不算全对。

lines.en: But of course, I know how it looked, so there’s no sense in arguing about it.
lines.zh: 不过当然，我知道那看起来像什么，所以争辩也没意义。

lines.en: scene black
Eventually, the two of us make it to Ayane’s place and are immediately escorted through a large courtyard to a traditional Japanese-style dojo where the party will be taking place.
lines.zh: 最后，我们总算到了Ayane家，立刻被人领着穿过一座大庭院，来到一间将用来举办派对的传统日式道场。

lines.en: We spend the next few hours setting everything up without a single break before the “festivities” finally begin...
lines.zh: 接下来的几个小时里，我们一刻不停地布置着一切，直到“庆典”终于开始……

$ miku_love += 1

lines.zh: {i}Miku的好感度提升到了 [miku_love]！{/i}

lines.zh: {i}大约三十分钟后……{/i}
